disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license, certification or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: found guilty by the board, by a majority vote of all its members, of the practice of any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining his license, certification or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of geology.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross negligence, incompetency or misconduct in the practice of engineering, in the practice of land surveying or in the practice of geology

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the code of ethics of the engineering profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of the code of ethics of the engineering profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for client or employer in professional matters other than as a faithful agent or trustee, or accepting remuneration beyond stated recompense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To act for the person's client or employer in professional matters otherwise than as a faithful agent or trustee, or to accept any remuneration other than the person's stated recompense for services rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to falsely or maliciously injure the professional reputation, prospects or business of another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to injure falsely or maliciously, directly or indirectly, the professional reputation, prospects or business of anyone.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to supplant another geologist after definite steps have been taken toward the other's employment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to supplant another engineer, land surveyor or geologist after definite steps have been taken toward the other's employment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Competing with another geologist for employment by use of unethical practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To compete with another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for employment by the use of unethical practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Reviewing the work of another geologist for the same client without knowledge of that geologist or without termination of the other's connection.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To review the work of another engineer, land surveyor or geologist for the same client, except with the knowledge of that engineer, land surveyor or geologist, or unless the connection of that engineer, land surveyor or geologist with the work has terminated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or render technical services without fair and just compensation commensurate with the services rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to practice in any field of geology in which the registrant is not proficient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To attempt to practice in any field of engineering, land surveying or geology in which the registrant is not proficient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or permitting use of the professional seal on work over which the person was not in responsible charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in the practice of geology not in accordance with the provisions of the act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for extortion, bribery or fraud (or nolo contendere plea) for conduct relating to the practice of geology.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct in the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology shall include, but not be limited to conviction for a criminal offense such as extortion, bribery or fraud or entry of a plea of nolo contendere to a charge thereof for conduct relating to the practice of engineering, land surveying or geology

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this act or any regulation promulgated by the board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of geology" means the practice or the offer to practice geology for others for a fee, including, but not limited to, describing the natural processes acting on earth materials, gases or fluids, predicting the probable occurrence of natural resources, predicting and locating natural or man-induced phenomena which may be useful or hazardous to mankind and recognizing, determining and evaluating geologic factors.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of geology" means the practice or the offer to practice geology for others for a fee, including, but not limited to, describing the natural processes acting on earth materials, gases or fluids, predicting the probable occurrence of natural resources, predicting and locating natural or man-induced phenomena which may be useful or hazardous to mankind and recognizing, determining and evaluating geologic factors.

methods_authorized.quote: The term shall also include the performance of geological service or work, consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, mapping and inspection of geological work required in implementing the provisions of any Federal or State law or regulation or the provisions of any ordinance, code, rule or permit required by any local political subdivision.

geologist_in_training_certificate_availa.quote: "Geologist-in-training" means a candidate for licensure as a professional geologist who has been granted a certificate as a geologist-in-training after successfully passing the required written examination in fundamental geology subjects

geology_education_minimum_semester_hours.quote: a minimum of thirty semester or forty-five quarter hours in geology, geophysics, geochemistry, engineering geology or their subdivisions

geology_education_upper_division_minimum.quote: of which at least twenty-four semester hours or an equivalent amount are in third or fourth year or graduate courses.

accepted_geology_majors.quote: a major in geology, geophysics, geochemistry or engineering geology

professional_geology_experience_years_re.quote: Has completed at least five years of professional geological work

supervised_experience_years_required.quote: a minimum of three years of professional geological work under the supervision of a licensed professional geologist

graduate_study_experience_credit_max_yea.quote: Credit for graduate study may not exceed a total of two years toward meeting the required number of years of professional geological work.

excluded_experience_types.quote: professional geological work does not include routine sampling, laboratory work or geological drafting.

scope_excludes_professions.quote: The term shall not include the practice of engineering, land surveying or landscape architecture for which separate licensure is required.

incidental_geology_exemption.quote: Individuals licensed as professional engineers, professional land surveyors or registered landscape architects may perform geological work which is incidental to their engineering, surveying or landscape architecture without being licensed as a professional geologist.

oil_gas_exploration_exemption.quote: The practice of individuals providing geologic services to businesses engaged in the exploration or development of gas or oil.

professional_seal_required.quote: Each person, registered under this act, shall obtain a seal of a design authorized by the board which shall bear the registrant's name and number and the legend "Registered Professional Engineer," "Registered Professional Land Surveyor" or "Registered Professional Geologist." Such seal, or a facsimile imprint of same, shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plats and reports issued by a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist.

pdh_units_per_renewal_period.quote: Each licensee shall be required to obtain twenty-four PDH units during the biennial renewal period.

pdh_carryover_max_units.quote: If a licensee exceeds the requirement in any renewal period, a maximum of twelve PDH units may be carried forward into the subsequent renewal period.

retired_status_license_available.quote: A licensee who lists his occupation as retired on the board-approved renewal form and certifies to the board that he no longer engages in the practice of his licensed profession shall be exempt from the requirement set forth in subsection (a), and the board shall issue him a retired-status license.

combined_licensing_board.quote: There is hereby established within the Department of State the State Registration Board for Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors and Geologists.

geologist_board_member_seats.quote: two of whom shall be registered professional geologists

multiple_licensure_reporting_required.quote: Any licensee of this Commonwealth who is also licensed to practice engineering, land surveying or geology in any other state, territory or country shall report this information to the board on the biennial renewal application.
